answer.summary: The research question must be strictly grounded in the explicitly reported per-interval retention rate from Kumar et al., 2024 under exact experimental conditions to ensure empirical validity and avoid speculative inference.

A bounded revision is required to anchor the question solely to observable, experimentally reported retention behavior under matching conditions to preserve fidelity to the source data and prevent ungrounded assumptions.
